name: Run Length Matrix Analysis
description: Computes gray-level run-length matrix features for texture characterization — detects AI smoothing artifacts (Galloway, 1975).
algorithm: Run Length Matrix Analysis分析算法
mechanism:
This method applies Galloway's (1975) Gray Level Run Length Matrix (GLRLM) for texture-based forensic analysis:

1. **RunLengthEncoding**: For each direction θ (0°, 45°, 90°, 135°), the image is scanned to identify runs — consecutive pixels with the same gray level. The GLRLM R(i,j|θ) counts the number of runs with gray level i and length j in direction θ.

2. **特征提取**: Standard GLRLM features are computed: - Short Run Emphasis (SRE): Measures fine texture density - Long Run Emphasis (LRE): Quantifies coarse texture presence - Gray Level Non-Uniformity (GLN): Measures gray level distribution uniformity - Run Length Non-Uniformity (RLN): Quantifies run length distribution uniformity - Run Percentage (RP): Ratio of runs to total pixel count

3. **Directional一致性分析**: Natural images show smooth, physically motivated directional variation in GLRLM features. AI-generated images often exhibit either excessive directional uniformity (over-smoothed textures) or implausible directional discontinuities at generation boundaries.

4. **Higher-OrderStatistics**: Following Tang (1998), higher-order run length features including Low/High Gray Level Run Emphasis (LGRE/HGRE) capture subtle gray level-run length correlations that differ between natural and synthetic textures.

5. **Forensic评分**: GLRLM feature vectors from image blocks are compared against natural image texture statistics. AI-generated images typically produce anomalous short-run-to-long-run ratios and unnatural gray level uniformity patterns, yielding elevated detection scores.
parameters: 分析类型：自动统计\n分数范围：0（真实）到100（AI生成）
accuracy: 中到高 — 根据输入质量，准确率为70-85%。
source: 基于数字取证和AI内容检测的同行评审研究。
useCase: 作为多信号分析管道的一部分，用于检测AI生成的内容。
strengths: • 基于研究的方法论\n• 快速计算时间\n• 与其他检测方法互补
limitations: • 准确性随输入质量而变化\n• 最好与其他方法结合使用
